5	from mdata.types import RawRow

8	def validate_rows(rows: Sequence[RawRow], tickers: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> list[RawRow]:
9	    """Positive closes only, the later duplicate wins, sorted by (date, ticker) (DATA-02)."""

13	    return sorted(kept, key=lambda row: (row.date, row.ticker))
